labs.title: Linear regression from the normal equation
labs.description: Train-only scaling, normal equation, ridge and gradient descent on the canonical Diabetes progression data. Every cell uses NumPy only.

labs.title: Logistic regression from scratch
labs.description: Sigmoid, gradient descent, confusion matrix and a threshold sweep on Breast Cancer Wisconsin — no scikit-learn import.

labs.title: KNN and K-means from distances
labs.description: Implement neighbour voting and Lloyd's algorithm, then compare k values and inspect cluster purity.

labs.title: A decision tree from Gini impurity
labs.description: Search threshold splits, build a recursive CART tree, sweep depth and count feature usage on the Wine data.

labs.title: PCA with SVD
labs.description: Standardise, decompose with SVD, read explained variance, project to two dimensions and measure reconstruction error.

colabPacks.title: Scikit-learn classification pack
colabPacks.description: Pipelines, logistic regression, random forest, cross-validation and permutation importance on Breast Cancer Wisconsin.

colabPacks.title: XGBoost regression pack
colabPacks.description: Linear, random-forest and XGBoost regressors with MAE/RMSE/R², residual inspection and feature importance.

colabPacks.title: Trees and XGBoost classifiers
colabPacks.description: Decision tree, random forest and XGBoost classifier side by side on Iris, with a depth sweep and confusion matrix.
